extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f(x)=x^n, then f'(x)=n x^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Power function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function of the form f(x)=x^n.

extracted_concepts.name: Real exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Exponent n allowed to be any real number in the power rule.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative f'(x) measures instantaneous rate of change.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiable function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function that has a derivative at points in its domain.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Multiple Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx[c f(x)] = c f'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Sum Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of a sum is the sum of derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Difference Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of a difference is the difference of derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function of the form a^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural exponential function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function e^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Number e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Unique number with lim_{h->0}(e^h-1)/h=1.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative of e^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(e^x)=e^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative of a^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(a^x)=a^x ln a.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit definition of e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: e is defined by lim_{h->0}(e^h-1)/h=1.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of finding derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Antidifferentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Inverse operation of differentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Integration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Operation connected to antidifferentiation by the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and antidifferentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: v(t)=s'(t), derivative of position.

extracted_concepts.name: Position function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function s(t) describing position over time.

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: a(t)=v'(t)=s''(t), derivative of velocity.

extracted_concepts.name: Second derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of the derivative, for example s''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal cost
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: MC=C'(x), derivative of a cost function.

extracted_concepts.name: Cost function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function C(x) representing cost.

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative interpreted as a rate of change.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent line approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses the derivative to estimate function values near a known point.

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function built from powers of x.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative of polynomials
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivatives of polynomial terms found using power, constant multiple, sum, and difference rules.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative of exponential functions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rules for derivatives of e^x and a^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural logarithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ln a appears in the derivative of a^x.
